description: This file contains a class implementing hook functions for the Drupal views_ui module, specifically for theme-related hooks and view preview handling.

classes.name: ViewsUiThemeHooks
classes.description: A class implementing hook functions for the views_ui module, managing theme hooks and view preview sections.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting configuration and module handler services.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Defines theme hook implementations for various views_ui templates.

methods.name: preprocessDisplayTabSetting
methods.description: Prepares variables for display tab setting templates, adjusting links and descriptions.

methods.name: preprocessViewsListingTable
methods.description: Prepares variables for views listing table, converting header and row attributes.

methods.name: preprocessDisplayTabBucket
methods.description: Prepares variables for display tab bucket templates, setting content and attributes.

methods.name: preprocessBuildGroupFilterForm
methods.description: Prepares variables for build group filter form, constructing filter groups and table.

methods.name: preprocessRearrangeFilterForm
methods.description: Prepares variables for rearrange filter form, setting up draggable rows and groups.

methods.name: preprocessStylePluginTable
methods.description: Prepares variables for style plugin table, building headers and rows for plugin options.

methods.name: preprocessViewPreviewSection
methods.description: Prepares variables for view preview sections, adding contextual links based on section type.

methods.name: preprocessViewsView
methods.description: Preprocesses view variables, rendering titles and contextual links for admin preview.

methods.name: themeSuggestionsViewsUiViewPreviewSection
methods.description: Provides theme suggestions for view preview sections based on section name.

methods.name: viewPreviewSectionHandlerLinks
methods.description: Generates contextual links for view section handlers, including edit and add links.

methods.name: viewPreviewSectionDisplayCategoryLinks
methods.description: Provides links to edit display categories for views.

methods.name: viewPreviewSectionRowsLinks
methods.description: Returns all contextual links for main view content sections.
